quests.title: The Braes Remembered
quests.summary: A Skye township wants to buy back its hill under the community right to buy. Gather the proof, the sums and the votes.

steps.text: Find the old kirk session book at Portree Kirk.
Ask Seonag in Portree what the book proves.
Join the Traders' guild at the Edinburgh Exchange and talk to the clerk.
Ask the Exchange auctioneer how the Enclosure sells an estate.
Read the court papers at Inverness Castle.
Beat the keeper at shinty and get the Fort William captain's blessing.
Look at the empty township in Glencoe.
Meet Fiona, then tell the organiser in Portree.
Visit the ruined house on Skye above the Braes Hall.
Take the proof back to Old Calum for the ballot.

quests.reward: A Land League Badge charm, Ceilidh Shortbread, a heilan, Scottish standing and the Braes Hall reopened on Skye.
